programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Lund
programme.desc: In this episode, Tareq visits Lund, a thousand-year old city in southern Sweden. Lund is surrounded by the richest farmland in the country, and we explore nearby islands and meet entrepreneurs making highly-regarded local products.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Bornholm
programme.desc: Tareq sails out to Bornholm, a Danish island close to southern tip of Sweden. The islanders are fiercely self-sufficient and this attitude reflects in the huge number of food producers making products that are sold both locally and internationally.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Jokkmokk

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Åland

programme.title: Forensic Files: Freeze Framed
programme.desc: In 2005, David Castor suffered a slow, agonizing death over a period of days. His wife maintained it was suicide, even though it was done with antifreeze.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Touch of Evil
programme.desc: In the 1990s, the media dubbed Richard Rogers the "Last Call Killer" because he targeted men in gay bars who were obviously intoxicated.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Textbook Murder
programme.desc: Avis Banks and her unborn child were brutally murdered. The body was discovered by her fiancé, Keyon Pittman. When police learned that Pittman was having affairs with other women, he became the prime suspect.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Filtered Out
programme.desc: In 2000, teenager Tara Munsey went missing after a work shift at a Virginia restaurant. Did she run away, or was she the victim of foul play?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Water Logged
programme.desc: In 1989, the dead bodies of Joan Rogers and her two teenage daughters were found floating in Tampa Bay.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Disappearance of Helle Crafts
programme.desc: In the series premiere of "Forensic Files", the longest-running true crime series in history, a Connecticut flight attendant goes missing. Police suspect her husband is guilty of murder, but can they prove it?

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Magic Bullet
programme.desc: A fifteen-year-old boy dies from a mysterious gunshot wound to the head while sitting in the lobby of his father's gun club. Ballistics, laser technology, made-to-scale models and the latest in forensic animation are used to find the cause.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The House That Roared
programme.desc: A woman disappears and her husband becomes the prime suspect — especially after police find a huge bloodstain on the carpet of their bedroom. When they spray the bedroom with Luminol, they discover it was awash with blood spatter.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Planted Evidence
programme.desc: One morning in a deserted area outside of Phoenix, a motorcyclist discovers the body of a young woman. She had been beaten, bound, strangled and possibly raped. Nearby plants tell investigators more about the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Wilson Murder
programme.desc: On the night of May 22, 1992, Betty Wilson returned home after a meeting and discovered her husband lying in a pool of blood. Jack Wilson had obviously been murdered — but how?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Held For Ransom
programme.desc: Wealth has its rewards, but it also brings its dangers. Kidnapping is one of them. No ordeal is more horrifying for a family than to have a child taken.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Millionaire Murder
programme.desc: A businessman went to Florida to make one last deal before he retired-he never returned home to his millions. Authorities examined who was closest to him and who stood to gain from his disappearance. But this time conventional rules didn't apply.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Family Torn
programme.desc: The parents of 11 yr. old Brittany Martinez knew their daughter was no runaway. Something had happened to her, something terrible. When they failed to find Brittany in their quiet Illinois neighborhood, they called the police.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Model Killer
programme.desc: It's a model's job to rivet the public's attention. But in 1984, some aspiring models began attracting publicity in a terrible new way.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Betrayed
programme.desc: Sometimes when a death seems to be accidental or the result of a tragic accident, it is up to forensic scientists to reveal the deception lying just below the surface.

programme.title: The New Detectives: False Witness
programme.desc: When a murder is committed and deceit clouds the evidence, investigators turn to science and technology to uncover the truth and expose a murderous lie and capture the killer.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Face Of Tragedy
programme.desc: Forensic Sculpting: Forensic sculptors retrieve people from oblivion. Using clay and an intricate knowledge of anatomy, forensic arts place a face on an unidentified skull, recreating the victim's likeness, which often leads to his name.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Coroner's Casebook
programme.desc: A good coroner provides what's necessary to solve a crime. A bad one can spoil an otherwise rock-solid case. Cyril Wecht and Henry Lee, two of the country's most respected coroners, share their cases and insights into crime solving.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Cold Blooded
programme.desc: Time of death is an important consideration in a murder investigation, but when a killer freezes, burns, or grinds his victim, even the most skilled medical examiner would be at a loss about how to calculate it.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Bad Blood
programme.desc: A army vet is found bleeding to death on the asphalt of a parking lot -- his chest littered with too many knife wounds to count. Kenda’s case is stuck in first gear until a gruesome clue appears.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The End
programme.desc: Kenda faces his most difficult case yet – the slaying of a young boy. The detective makes the most consequential decision of his career.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: When the Music Stops
programme.desc: Vietnam War veteran Charles Walker is found unconscious, after a stabbing attack so savage even 45 units of blood couldn’t save his life.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The Monster Awakes
programme.desc: When Julie Smith reports being sexually assaulted, Lt. Joe Kenda and his Sex Crimes Unit discover a terrifying similarity to other attacks on the east side of town.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Last Fare
programme.desc: A young man is found dead behind the wheel of his taxi. With robbery seeming unlikely, Kenda and Gaenzle wonder if this was personal.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 7: The Milky Way
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 8: Extravehicular Activity
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: One Small Step: Neil Armstrong
programme.desc: Neil Armstrong has stamped his place in History by becoming the first person to walk on the moon.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Astronauts
programme.desc: Who are these people that venture into space? Once they were test pilots, then scientists and engineers now teachers, politicians and paying tourists what does it take to earn the astronaut wings?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Space: Getting There
programme.desc: The new surge in space transportation, privately owned companies vying for government contracts and private entrepreneurs looking to build hotels in space.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Orbit
programme.desc: Chances are, you are watching this program by satellite, one way or the other. Every day we use these wonders of human design, from communication and weather observation, to GPS and recourse management.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Shore to Shore
programme.desc: With low Earth orbit delegated to private companies, NASA is free to develop the deep space hardware for missions to Mars and beyond. The Orion space craft and SLS launch system are well on their way to delivering this capability.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Mars: Adapt or Leave
programme.desc: Air, water, food, electricity and fuel all the essentials to explore the solar system, this episode explores the innovative plans for astronauts to grow their own food and extract water and fuel at their destinations.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Emissiaries
programme.desc: NASA and others are developing new innovative propulsion systems, Ion thrusters, solar sails and the science fiction 'Warp drive' is not as far away as once thought.

programme.title: Svenske krimsaker

programme.title: Svenske krimsaker
programme.desc: En familie som rammes av en husbrann klarer å unnslippe flammene, men alt de eier har blitt til aske. Det som først ser ut til å være en ulykke, viser seg å være mye mer komplisert.

programme.title: Svenske krimsaker

programme.title: Henry Danger: Hvor er Otto?
programme.desc: Otto, Skolepapegøyen til Piper, begynner å repetere 'Henry er Kid Danger'. Henry og Jasper må dekke over inntil Ray, Charoltte og Schwoz har ordnet opp i det.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Hele Bilskyfamilien
programme.desc: Nervene til Henry blir satt på prøve, når Piper inviterer den nye kjæresten og familen hans på middag.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Hemmelig Rom
programme.desc: Captain Man avslører et hemmelig rom i mannegrotten. Litt sjalu lager Charlotte, Jasper og Schwoz et eget rom. Når de begynner å slåss om hvem som har det kuleste rommet, tar det helt av.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Middag med Bigfoot
programme.desc: Når gjengen blir venner med Bigfoot i skogen, prøver Kid Danger og Captain Man å hjelpe ham med å bli kvitt en ivrig jeger som prøver å fange ham.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Huset blir hjemsøkt
programme.desc: Schwoz finner opp en støvsuger for å hjelpe Henry med å vaske huset, men den suger, uheldigvis, opp Charlotte. Når familen hører Charlotte, tror de at støvsugeren er hjemsøkt. Ray må distrahere dem, mens Henry prøver å få henne ut.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Drømme-Kiden
programme.desc: Når Charlotte har en drøm om at hun nesten kysser Kid Danger, prøver hun aktivt å unngå Henry i redsel for at hun har sanndrømt.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Muldvarpkrigen
programme.desc: Gjengen tror de har funnet de perfekte tunnlene for å komme til hele Solsyn, men det er til de møter de som bor i dem.

programme.title: Henry Danger: En kjærlighetshistorie 2001
programme.desc: Ting tar litt av, når Schwoz installerer et nytt operativsystem på datamaskinen som er designet til å oppdage og eliminere alle trusler mot Solsyn.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Null null Danger
programme.desc: Kid Danger og Captain Man prøver å fange mafiabossen Rob Moss ved å infiltrere datterens bursdagsselskap.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Musikalen del 1
programme.desc: Når Frankini bruker et apparat som legger en musikal-forbannelse på Solsyn, må Kid Danger og Captain Man redde alle sammen. Men når Captain Man hiver inn håndkleet, må Kid Danger minne ham på hvordan man er en helt.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Musikalen del 2
programme.desc: Når Frankini bruker et apparat som legger en musikal-forbannelse på Solsyn, må Kid Danger og Captain Man redde alle sammen. Men når Captain Man hiver inn håndkleet, må Kid Danger minne ham på hvordan man er en helt.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg skal gjøre Sam jentete
programme.desc: Da Sam innrømmer at hun liker en gutt på skolen, lærer Carly henne hvordan hun kan lokke ham til seg ved å oppføre seg mere feminint. Spencer er overbevist om at en jente liker ham pga. smokingen hans, så han går med den hele tiden.

programme.title: iCarly: A date en pøbel del 1
programme.desc: Når Carly dater er en tøffing, prøver hun å holde forholdet skjult for Spencer. Og Sam betaler Freddie for å lage en hjemmeside der hun kan legge ut alle sine ekle videofavoritter.

programme.title: iCarly: Gjenforening med Missy
programme.desc: Da Carlys gamle venninne Missy flytter tilbake til Seattle, tror Sam at Missy prøver å skifte henne ut som Carlys bestevenninne.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg må ha skap 239
programme.desc: Når Sam og Freddie begge to vinner konkurransen for skolens beste skap, slir de nødt til å dele skap. Carly ber Spencer gi henne timer i billedkunst.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly utdelingen
programme.desc: Carly, Sam og Freddie holder en iCarly-galla for de beste bruker-bidragene i iCarly, og hyller pristagerne live på web-showet. Spencer verver europeiske badedraktmodeller for å hjelpe ham å lage premiestatuettene.

programme.title: iCarly: Tvillinger
programme.desc: Freddie prøver å bevise at Melanie, Sams tvillingesøster, er Sam i forkledning. Når Carly underviser Spencers nemesis, Chuck, prøver Spencer å overbevise henne om at Chuck er ond.

programme.title: iCarly: A date en pøbel del 2
programme.desc: Når Carly oppdager at hennes tøffe kjæreste Griffin samler på små Pee Wee Babies, må hun ta stilling til om hun holder ut å date en kar som har en kosedyrsamling. I mens forsøker Spencer å hjelpe Sam med å bli kvitt et mareritt.

programme.title: iCarly: iKamp mot Dingo
programme.desc: Dingo-kanalen har stjålet idéer fra iCarly, så Carly, Sam, Freddie og Spencer drar til Dingos Studio for å fortelle manusforfatterne hva de mener om det.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg tror de kysset
programme.desc: Da Sam kommer til å avsløre overfor Carly at hun og Freddie smugkysset, konfronterer Carly dem med hvorfor de ikke fortalte henne om det. Og Spencer underviser fanger i billedkunst i fengselet.

programme.title: iCarly: Kokkekamp
programme.desc: Når Carl, Sam og Freddie vinner over en berømt tv-kokk i en matlagningskonkurranse, vil ikke kokken lage mat mer og nekter å komme ut av soverommet sitt. Spencer prøver å oppfylle en fremtidsdrøm.

programme.title: iCarly: Rektor kampen
programme.desc: Når Carly, Sam og Freddie får rektor Franklin sparket, overtar miss Briggs og mr. Howard ledelsen og innfører strenge regler. Og Spencer leier en gammel rodeostjerne til å lære ham å ri på en mekanisk okse.

programme.title: Awkward: Responsibly Irresponsible
programme.desc: En klassekamerat dør, og Jenna tenker over det inntrufne, sørger og tar ansvar for noe hun har holdt hemmelig for Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: A Little Less Conversation
programme.desc: Matty blir fjern når han finner ut om Jennas mulige graviditet, og Jenna er villig til nesten hva som helst for å slippe å prate om det.

programme.title: Awkward: Let's Talk About Sex
programme.desc: Jennas far tar saken i egne hender for å få snakke med Mattys foreldre om deres barns forhold.

programme.title: Awkward: Indecent Exposure
programme.desc: Når Matty flytter inn hos Hamiltonfamilien, oppdager Jenna at samboerskap er mer enn det hun hadde regent med.

programme.title: Awkward: That Girl Strikes Again
programme.desc: Spøkelsene fra Jennas fortid kommer fram igjen, og det gjør også hennes usikkerhet - akkurat i tide til Halloweenfeiringen i Palos Hills.

programme.title: Awkward: Guilt Trippin'
programme.desc: Jennas første kavaler til Homecomingballet roter opp gamle skyldfølelser rundt jenta hun en gang var og jentene som ikke har kavalerer.

programme.title: Awkward: Rubbed Raw and Reeling
programme.desc: En utfordring fra Mr. Hart tvinger Jenna til å eksponere seg offentlig, og dermed konfronteres hun med noen alarmerende og nye innsikter i sin person.

programme.title: Awkward: Reality Check
programme.desc: Etter en sen kaffe med Collin klarer ikke Jenna å slutte å tenke på ham, eller hva det betyr å være forelsket og det å ha en kjæreste.

programme.title: Awkward: Redefining Jenna
programme.desc: Spenningen stiger mellom Jenna og Matty når Collin inviterer henne til en snerten fotovisning hjemme hos ham selv.

programme.title: Awkward: Surprise!
programme.desc: Etter å ha klint med Collin på impuls, bestemmer Jenna seg for å slutte å være utro før Matty finner ut om det.

programme.title: Awkward: And Then What Happened
programme.desc: Hva skjedde egentlig på overraskelsesfesten - og er det virkelig helt slutt mellom Jenna og Matty? Det vet bare de to, men vennene deres prøver å finne ut sannheten.

programme.title: Nirvana MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: Nirvana's classic acoustic performance recorded at Sony Music Studios in New York City on November 18, 1993.

programme.title: Another Period: Annulment

programme.title: Another Period: The Prince And The Pauper

programme.title: Another Period: Trial of the Century

programme.title: Detroiters: Dream Cruise

programme.title: Detroiters: Husky Boys

programme.title: Broad City: Stolen Phone

programme.title: Broad City: Hurricane Wanda
programme.desc: Abbi og Ilana klarer sig igennem stormen med hjælp fra deres venner (Jaimé, Lincoln og Jeremy), men de får desværre selskab af Bevers og hans søster. Et spil 'Who Done It?' udspiller sig, mens orkanan raser udenfor.

programme.title: Tosh.0: DJ Decimal Point
